insight: Founded by Jordanian-born Amjad Masad; its Agent drove ARR from ~$10M to over $150M in 2025, lifting Replit to a $9B valuation by 2026.
name: Replit
tagline: Cloud IDE + Agent that builds, runs, and deploys from a prompt.
description: A browser IDE with Replit Agent — describe an app and it scaffolds, codes, runs, and deploys it, with a hosted database and one-click publish. Zero local setup, ships from anywhere.

modelSupport.notes: Replit Agent builds + deploys using frontier models.

edge: Build, database, and hosting all live in the browser, so its Agent can ship a working app with zero local setup.
cons: Less control than a local IDE
